revisions: Previous statement that a request-aware seam was only hypothetical is narrowed: exact v2.2.0 has a public experimental CallToolWithAlternateFilters pipeline, and WithTasks appends its filter there, so a pre-Tasks typed filter can emit requestState before task creation.

Tool-body MRTR remains unsuitable for this composition because stock WithTasks converts InputRequiredException from the background tool pipeline into a task failure. The preflight must return InputRequiredResult directly from the outer alternate-result filter.

A custom store can use signed server-minted op_id as deterministic unique taskId and fail duplicate create before Task.Run. Together with an outer filter returning the verified existing CreateTaskResult, this closes response-loss unknown-handle and concurrent blind-retry duplication in the source-equivalent fixtures.

New counterexample: exact RunAsTaskAsync durably creates the task before volatile Task.Run scheduling. Crash between those steps leaves a discoverable but unexecuted Working task; deterministic handle recovery alone does not redrive it. Handle recovery, execution liveness, and external-effect duplicate safety must be proved separately.
